topPRs.title: deployer: reorganize with subpackages
topPRs.author: bitwiseguy
topPRs.body:
This pr restructures the `ops/internal/deployer` package, adding some subpackages for better organization. This is one step towards addressing the issue identified [here](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1058#discussion_r2124910251) where its difficult to add a new state version. Follow-up steps will be to extract more duplicate code from the `state/vX.go` files into the `state.state.go` file. Instead of having a flat `deployer` package, we now have the following dir structure:
```
|_ deployer
   |_ opaque_map
   |_ state
      |_ configs
```

topPRs.title: chore: bump optimism dep to import op-fetcher mipsImpl fix
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Imports [ethereum-optimism/optimism#20347](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20347) (\"fix(op-fetcher): guard against zero mipsImpl before calling oracle()\") into superchain-registry by bumping the `github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism` Go dependency.

That fix resolves the `FetchChainInfo.s.sol` revert that has been failing the `daily-codegen` CircleCI workflow for several weeks against chains with zeroed-out permissioned game implementations (e.g. OP Mainnet `chainId=10`, Base Mainnet `chainId=8453`).

This is the import step only — does **not** include any regenerated codegen artifacts. Run `just codegen` on top to refresh `chainList.json` / `chainList.toml` / `addresses.json` once this lands.

## Changes

- `ops/go.mod`: `optimism v1.13.4-0.20250605160538-158e990b76a8` → `v1.16.14-0.20260427160136-8ef523c935ba` (the merge commit of optimism#20347)
- `ops/go.mod` replace: `op-geth` → `v1.101702.1-rc.1` to match optimism's own `go.mod` at that commit
- `ops/go.mod` + `ops/go.work`: `go` directive `1.23.1` → `1.24.0` (required transitively by the new optimism revision)
- `mise.toml`: `go 1.23.1` → `1.24.0` to keep CI's mise toolchain in sync with `go.mod`
- `ops/internal/manage/staging.go`: drop the `dc.CustomGasTokenAddress` branch — the field was removed upstream when CGT support was deprecated; it was the only blocker to building against the new optimism

## Test plan

- [x] `go build ./...` in `ops/` is clean
- [x] `just codegen --l1-rpc-urls <sepolia>,<mainnet> --superchains=mainnet,sepolia` runs end-to-end with no `FetchChainInfo` reverts (chains 8453 and 10 now process cleanly; previously they reverted)
- [ ] CI green
- [ ] Trigger `daily_codegen_dispatch` post-merge to confirm the scheduled workflow recovers

## Follow-ups

- Steven's PR #1200 was filed for the same root cause but pinned to `optimism v1.13.7`, which does **not** include #20347. After this lands, that PR's optimism + mise bumps become redundant; the `golangci-lint 1.61.0 → 1.64.8` change there is the only net-new contribution.

topPRs.title: fix: bump op-fetcher dep to fix daily-codegen CI
topPRs.author: stevennevins
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- The `daily-codegen` CircleCI scheduled workflow has been failing since ~Feb 4 (~5 weeks)
- Root cause: `op-fetcher`'s `FetchChainInfo.s.sol` script reverts against current on-chain contracts (OP Sepolia + OP Mainnet)
- Bumps `ethereum-optimism/optimism` from a June 2025 pseudo-version to `v1.13.7` with matching `op-geth` (`v1.101602.3-rc.1`)

## CI failure logs

First failure (Feb 4):
```
error fetching onchain configs: failed to fetch chain info for chainId 11155420:
failed to run FetchChainInfo.s.sol script: execution reverted
```

Latest failure (Mar 13):
```
error fetching onchain configs: failed to fetch chain info for chainId 10:
failed to run FetchChainInfo.s.sol script: execution reverted
```

## Test plan

- [x] `go build ./...` compiles
- [x] `go test ./...` — no new test failures (3 pre-existing local-only failures confirmed)
- [ ] Trigger `daily_codegen_dispatch` via CircleCI API to verify the fix end-to-end
